subject: POC MAP — env gating, key handoff, IP allowlist & VPC peering cadence
messages:
From: Liam Perez <liam.perez@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-07T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: POC readiness and MAP items (API keys, IP allowlist, peering)

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We're ready to move forward with a short evaluation (POC) but need to lock the operational items in the MAP so we can hit our compliance window. High-level asks from our infra/security team: 

- Short-lived API keys or a service account model with scope-limited credentials.
- Static egress IPs for allowlist (we control the DNS and firewall rules).
- Clarify VPC peering vs Shared VPC option — we prefer peering but need a window for change control.
- Org-level setup: a Redwood org dedicated to Acme, and role-based onboarding for 3 engineers.

Can you share a MAP with clear milestones and an activation cadence? We want to start network prep the week of Oct 20th and aim to finish the POC by Nov 7th.

Also attaching our internal peering constraints doc (small attachment).

Thanks,
Liam
Liam Perez
Head of Platform Engineering
Acme Health
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Perez <liam.perez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness and MAP items (API keys, IP allowlist, peering)

Liam — thanks for the clear list. Attaching our working MAP (Acme_MAP_v1.2.pdf) and a concise preflight-checklist.csv that mirrors the MAP milestones. Quick summary / proposed cadence: 

1) Week of Oct 13: Org provisioning and RBAC — we create a dedicated Acme org and invite 3 engineers (camila to own).
2) Oct 20–22: Network prep — you provide CIDR ranges and preferred peering window; we provide static egress IP options.
3) Oct 23–27: API credential model — choice between short-lived API keys (recommended for eval) or a service-account flow for longer tests.
4) Oct 28-Nov 3: Peering and firewall verification — canary traffic, KV cache validation.
5) By Nov 7: Acceptance demo and sign-off.

Ben (cc'd) will own the peering coordination and technical handoff. Marissa will own security/compliance artifacts and the MAP signature flow.

Two immediate asks for your team so we can schedule the network window:
- Confirm CIDR blocks (VPC) and whether you require inbound rules to Redwood-managed endpoints.
- Confirm preferred maintenance window for peering (we can support a 2–4 hour change window Oct 21 or Oct 22).

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.2.pdf (MAP draft), preflight-checklist.csv (milestone checklist).

I'll also share a HubSpot MAP link and DocuSign for the MAP acceptance once you confirm dates.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Perez <devops@acmehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-08T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness and MAP items (technical: peering & IPs)

On Tue, Oct 7, 2025 at 11:03 AM Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Two immediate asks for your team so we can schedule the network window:
> - Confirm CIDR blocks (VPC) and whether you require inbound rules to Redwood-managed endpoints.
> - Confirm preferred maintenance window for peering (we can support a 2–4 hour change window Oct 21 or Oct 22).

Liam — quick technical notes from our side to help you decide: 

- We support both VPC peering and Shared VPC. For the POC we recommend classic VPC peering (simpler and faster to approve) unless you have a policy that requires Shared VPC.
- If peering: please provide the non-overlapping CIDR range in the form 10.X.Y.0/24 (or a /20 if you need larger).
- Static egress: we can allocate two static NAT addresses in our egress pool. If you require allowlisting on your side, we'll give you the two IPs and an ASN if needed.
- For the API credential model: short-lived API keys (90m TTL) are easiest for the POC. If you'd prefer a long-lived service account we can issue restricted keys scoped to the evaluation models.

Action items for your infra team (if possible before Oct 15):
- Confirm CIDR blocks for VPC peering.
- Provide firewall change ticket owner and preferred maintenance window (Oct 21 or 22).

I'll open a peering-request ticket on our side and share the ticket id once created.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Ops <devops@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Perez <liam.perez@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2025-10-09T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness and MAP items (technical: peering & IPs)

Thanks Ben — full answers below: 

- CIDR for Acme-POC-VPC: 10.52.0.0/20 (reserved for the eval).
- We do not need inbound rules to Redwood-managed endpoints beyond the peering; outbound egress allowlist is what matters for our firewalls.
- Preferred maintenance window: Oct 22, 02:00–04:00 PT (off-hours for us).
- For credentials: we'll take short-lived API keys for the POC, but please include a service-account option in the MAP in case we extend.

Also: can you provide a contact on-call for the peering window (phone + slack)? We need a point of contact to coordinate if the peering needs roll-back.

Regards,
Dev Ops (on behalf of Acme infra)
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Ops <devops@acmehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Liam Perez <liam.perez@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2025-10-10T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness and MAP items (finalize window & canary plan)

Perfect — thanks for the CIDR and time window. Quick confirmations and next steps: 

- Peering window set: Oct 22, 02:00–04:00 PT. Ben will be on-call (slack: @ben_carter, mobile: +1-415-555-0198).
- We will allocate two static egress IPs and share them by Oct 17 for your allowlist.
- Credential model: we'll provision 90m short-lived API keys for the three engineers; Marissa will generate the onboarding matrix and SRM evidence artifact.
- Canary plan: first 10% of traffic from a test VPC to validate token rotation and KV-cache behavior for 30 minutes, then ramp to 50% if no errors, final cutover only after your sign-off.

I will upload the signed MAP (DocuSign link created) and the final preflight CSV once the DocuSign is completed. DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/Acme-MAP/ACME-2025-089 (expires in 7 days).

If any change is needed to the window, please flag by Oct 17 EOD. Otherwise we'll treat Oct 17–21 as the notification period and Oct 22 for the peering.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you into a running eval.

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: Acme_MAP_v1.2.pdf, preflight-checklist.csv
